contest.measure_text: CITY PLANNING DEPARTMENT. CHARTER AMENDMENT PL. Shall the City Charter be amended to: establish a Neighborhood Appeals Commission to replace Area Planning Commissions and establish a process for City Council review of Neighborhood Appeals Commission and City Planning Commission decisions; change the timing and process for City Council action on certain planning decisions; grant the Planning Department the authority to investigate, hear, and determine applications for quasi-judicial review; and allow for changes to floor area regulations by ordinance? Supporters: Raymond Meza, Chair, Charter Reform Commission; Roy Samaan, President, Engineers & Architects Association Opponents: None submitted.
contest.office: LOS ANGELES CITY GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION - MEASURE PL
